defects.description: Unit test uses a pid-named dir under temp_dir with no drop guard, so a failing assertion leaves the directory behind (the CLI tests use a TempDir guard).
Idempotence keyed on config/ only; if dotfiles/ exists without config/ the os.makedirs(dot) call raises. Harmless in the current single-call flow.
Following links on Windows (metadata + GetFileType on the handle) is compile-checked only; no native Windows symlink evidence. Disclosed by the implementer; not a code defect.

summary: Correct, minimal root-cause fix: pre-open symlink_metadata replaced by metadata (follows links); the authoritative K14 check on the opened handle (O_NONBLOCK + fstat, Windows GetFileType) is unchanged, so links retargeted to a FIFO/device are still refused without blocking; O_NOCTTY is a sound hardening. No path or OS string echo (io_kind only). tui shares load_file. Tests cover absolute/relative/chained/through-linked-dir links byte-identically with and without --json, an invalid profile behind a link, and K14 through links (FIFO, socket, /dev/null, dir abs/rel, dangling, loop), plus PTY cases; the obsolete 'link is refused' assertion was removed rather than left contradictory. Only minor test-hygiene nits.
